title: Route decision
description: Output of the right-sizing classifier (POST /route/classify, or classify() imported directly). Produced by Member A; B maps tier to a model in the routing rules and uses cache to decide whether the semantic cache may answer.

tier.description: small only when the prompt shows an easy-task signal and no hard-task signal; everything else is large.

confidence.description: Rule strength, not a calibrated probability: 1 for images/tools, 0.9 for two or more matching signals, 0.8 for one, 0.5 when nothing matched.

time_sensitive.description: The answer is likely to change over time.

signals.description: Machine-readable rule ids that fired, e.g. lookup, code, math, relative_time. Log them with the receipt.

reasons.description: One readable sentence per signal, for the dashboard.
